tagline: A looped LLM that reuses the same layers twice, tested with 1 to 4 loops

scenes.narration: Day 55: SenseNova-Loop-9B, a language model that runs the same block of layers twice. We changed how many times.

scenes.heading: What is it?
bullets: Layers 4 to 27 run twice with shared weights
scenes.narration: It stores only 32 decoder layers, but runs layers 4 to 27 twice with the same weights, so every token gets 56 layer computations.

steps.narration: Tokens go through the first four layers, then into the looped block.
The block's output is fed back into the same layers once more before the last four layers. The loop count is a single setting, so we switched it from one to four.

scenes.heading: What we found
scenes.caption: Correct answers out of 20 multiplications, two loops vs. one
scenes.narration: With one loop, it got only 1 of 20 multiplications right, down from 19. More loops did not help: four loops scored 11. The weights were trained for two passes, and two worked best.
